previous_public_limitation: Earlier publication redacted decompressed tar bytes as an opaque stream. Its tar parser reaches only five of 186 original entries before a bad header; do not treat that reconstructed stream as the exact source archive.
tar_encoding_qualification: Original entries use GNU ustar headers; the reconstruction uses POSIX ustar/PAX encoding and adds PAX path headers for 12 long names. Decoded names, types and selected ownership/mode/time fields match; raw headers, checksums, offsets and outer gzip OS byte differ.
qualification: Additive tar-aware reconstruction from the exact locally retained original. Real local paths remain redacted; two identified non-path slash phrases and one source regex literal are retained. Original and public per-member hashes are distinct where changed. Embedded original manifests retain their historical original-byte references and are not regenerated. The original archive, exact changed member bytes and private path values are retained locally; public reconstruction is not byte-identical and does not prove historic reads, current cleanliness, checkpoint3821 recovery, uninterrupted custody or product behavior.
